newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ital-Thai Dev closes US$95 million loan.
newsitem.headline: Ital-Thai Dev closes US$95 million loan.

text.p: Italian-Thai Development has completed a US$95 million multicurrency term loan facility, arranger Sanwa International Finance said Friday.

Bankers said the five-year amortising loan pays a coupon of 60 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate. It has an average life of 3.5 years and an all-in return of 68.6 basis points, they said.
Sanwa kept a large share of the transaction with US$20 million.
Other arrangers Mitsubishi Trust and Banking Corp each kept US$10 million.
Four other banks joined the syndication as co-lead managers. They are BNP BIBF, Fuji Bank, Gulf International Bank and Mitsui Trust and Banking Corp with US$7 million each.
